title: Polynomial-time verdicts decide their languages
statement: Let the mode flag be either true or false, and suppose the function mapping each Boolean word $z$ to the one-bit word containing the corresponding verifier verdict is polynomial-time computable. Then the language accepted by that verifier belongs to $\mathrm{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: the mode flag is either true or false
the corresponding one-bit verdict function is polynomial-time computable
replaced:
For either mode flag: if the single-bit function computing the verifier verdict is
polynomial-time computable, then the corresponding verifier language belongs to the
class $\mathrm{P}$.
